proof: 0x23D0520 initializes starting from CRegiment+0x38*100000, soft to zero, and current to starting when the type fights in main
0x23D05E4..0x23D05FA leaves current at zero when type+0xA0A says the type does not fight in main, so starting-current-soft initially contains uncommitted reserve rather than hard loss
0x23091DB..0x230926B moves starting for a non-main row or current for a main row into soft and zeroes current when routing
0x23CDFC3 adds the soft delta to entry+0x20 and 0x23CDFCB subtracts soft+hard from entry+0x18
for a main-fighting retained row, pursuit reduction of soft becomes permanent hard and preserves starting=current+soft+hard
hard_casualty_derivation.non_main_policy: publish per_entry_hard status unavailable with raw null and reason non_main_reserve_not_distinguishable_from_hard; never treat starting-current-soft as hard

tick_start_cache_semantics.authoritative_current_values: retained entry+0x18 rows after the current tick's damage writes
tick_start_cache_semantics.cached_values: CCombatSide+0x98 total and +0xA0 levy subtotal as refreshed at the start of the tick
exact_order: 0x2309E80 calls 0x23CB840 for both sides at 0x2309E8F/0x2309EA1 before calculating damage
0x2309FE8 and the 0x230A002 tail call 0x23CE080 after the refresh
0x23CE080 reaches 0x23CDF70, whose 0x23CDFC3 write increments entry+0x20 soft and whose 0x23CDFCB write decrements entry+0x18 current
the tick does not call 0x23CB840 a second time after those entry writes, so a stable paused main-phase frame can contain stale +0x98/+0xA0 caches
tick_start_cache_semantics.query_policy: never call 0x23CB840; preserve both caches, derive current totals from retained entries, and publish truthful stored_*_matches_derived booleans
tick_start_cache_semantics.availability_policy: a false match boolean is legal and does not make the frame unavailable; two complete samples must still match
